build_constant_iteration_strategy: build a ConstantIterationStrategy that always returns a fixed dataset index for single-task multitask training
build_round_robin_iteration_strategy: build a RoundRobinIterationStrategy that cycles through datasets one by one in round robin fashion
build_random_iteration_strategy: build a RandomIterationStrategy that randomly selects a dataset index each time it is called
build_size_proportional_iteration_strate: build a SizeProportionalIterationStrategy that samples datasets proportionally to their sizes for balanced multitask training
build_ratios_iteration_strategy: build a RatiosIterationStrategy that samples datasets based on user-specified sampling ratios in the config
